**Rimlight** lights the edges of your screen with a soft glow that follows your music. The color comes from the album art, and the glow moves with the beat.

**Install:** download **RimlightSetup.exe** below (**RimlightSetup-arm64.exe** on Windows on ARM) and run it. It installs for your user account, with no admin prompt, and keeps itself up to date. Windows may say *Windows protected your PC* because the app isn't code-signed yet. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

**Portable:** unzip **Rimlight-win-Portable.zip** (or **Rimlight-win-arm64-Portable.zip**) into any folder and run `Rimlight.exe`.
